description: Explains a cron expression in plain English and lists its next runs in UTC and in a time zone. Five fields (minute hour day month weekday), or six with seconds first. Names (MON, JAN) and steps are supported. Computed in the Worker; no network call. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

tz.description: IANA time zone for the local times, e.g. Europe/Berlin (default UTC)
